Editorial interior photograph for a quiet luxury home magazine. Soft natural window light from the left, warm daylight around 4300K, gentle real shadows. Limewashed warm grey plaster wall, white oak or walnut surface, oat linen. Muted palette, subtle film grain. Photorealistic, not CGI.

The flowers must match the attached product reference photos exactly: same flower shape, petal layers, color and color edges, leaf shape and texture, bud shape. Keep real scale: Classic stems are about 43 cm long, flower head about 9 cm.

Burgundy classic roses with their buds in a cream handmade stoneware vase on a walnut table, low late-afternoon winter sun from the left, deeper but soft shadows, oat linen runner, calm and warm, not festive, no candles, no ornaments.

No text, no logos, no people's faces, no paper vase or gift box, no extra flower types, no water in the vase, no plastic look.

ADDITIONAL EXECUTION CONSTRAINTS (separate from the verbatim A+B+C+D blocks):
Output a single 4:5 image. Use the maximum native image size available in the actual generation tool. Do not resize, upscale, sharpen or resample the delivered image. If native output falls below the stated minimum, retain it unchanged and report its actual dimensions. Use only Burgundy Classic from the attached same-color product references. Flowers may be fewer than one set, never more: at most 6 stems, 6 open blooms and 12 buds throughout the entire image, including any background or reflection. Do not add other flowers, eucalyptus, extra buds, cut stems or extra bouquets. Stem lengths are nominal source claims, not independent measurements. Stems naturally enter the vessel; do not place the entire nominal stem length above the rim or enlarge the bouquet relative to furniture. Keep the flower vessel dry. No hands, people, unpacking, packaging, paper vase, gift box, text, lettering or watermark. Keep additional decorative props within two; add no objects beyond those specified by C. Product references control flowers and quantity. Style references control lighting, palette and materials only. The output is AI-generated REVIEW; no approval, website integration or publication is authorized. Every Classic rose stem has one open bloom and two original buds; do not count green sepals as extra buds.

QUANTITY/IDENTITY CLARIFICATION: Arrange ONLY FOUR Burgundy Classic rose stems, FOUR open main heads and no more than EIGHT closed buds total, clearly countable, a permitted subset of the six-stem pack. Preserve the high-centered layered Classic rose form, folded pointed petal edges, burgundy wine/plum hue and the original green sepals from the three Burgundy product references. Do not borrow Austin rosette anatomy or Coral color from the lighting-only style references. No additional decorative objects: just flowers, cream stoneware vase, walnut table and oat linen runner. For this WM mobile slot use a native 4:5 portrait composition, whole flowers and vase comfortably inside frame; do not crop, resize or letterbox afterwards.
